newsitem.title: USA: Air Products raises North American prices.
newsitem.headline: Air Products raises North American prices.

text.p: Air Products and Chemicals Inc said Tuesday it will increase prices for liquid and gaseous hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, argon and helium for merchant customers in the United States and Canada, effective October 1, or as contracts permit.

Price increases will average five to 10 percent for hydrogen, four to six percent for oxygen and nitrogen, and three to five percent for argon and helium, depending on local supply conditions, regional production costs, and contract terms, the company said.

The higher prices are necessary to offset increased costs of raw materials, production, and distribution caused by rising costs of natural gas, power, diesel fuel, labor, and maintenance, it explained.
Air Products said the increases are also necessary to sustain adequate returns on investment required to develop new industrial gas sources to meet increased customer demand.
